purpose: Define the minimum typed inputs and authority checks a later integrated prototype would need; this artifact is not a production data set or executable contract.

candidate_record_fields.type: stable semantic identifier
candidate_record_fields.authority: derived only after governed deterministic section selection

candidate_record_fields.type: boundary IDs, source edge IDs, endpoint identities and support resolution
candidate_record_fields.authority: exact canonical geometry/support references; no inferred subcell geometry

candidate_record_fields.type: ordered pair of plate IDs
candidate_record_fields.authority: B6N2 pair-level process scope; for current process [1,3]

candidate_record_fields.type: position on supported interface
candidate_record_fields.authority: deterministic geometric selection recipe required

candidate_record_fields.type: radial/up, local interface tangent, cross-interface normal and Buck x-axis
candidate_record_fields.authority: edge frame can be derived under existing tangent and n_AB conventions; section axis and endpoint frame transport require a binding

candidate_record_fields.type: plate-side identity and signed side order
candidate_record_fields.authority: explicit per-side plate identities; A/B mapping must be frozen for section

candidate_record_fields.type: contract ID, Euler source semantic hash and POST_EVENT state ID
candidate_record_fields.authority: R6_POST_EVENT_KINEMATIC_AUTHORITY_V1 and exact canonical causal state

candidate_record_fields.type: two spatial endpoints and plate identity on each
candidate_record_fields.authority: requires a governed finite section and X_e or other section extent

candidate_record_fields.type: two global Cartesian vectors
candidate_record_fields.authority: deterministic rigid-sphere derivation at each endpoint after endpoint positions/sides are bound

candidate_record_fields.type: global Cartesian vector at one common interface point
candidate_record_fields.authority: R*[(omega_B-omega_A) cross r] under B6N2 and planetary radius

candidate_record_fields.type: signed scalar
candidate_record_fields.authority: delta_v dot n_AB; positive is kinematic opening in existing diagnostic convention

candidate_record_fields.type: signed scalar
candidate_record_fields.authority: delta_v dot t_edge; retain as a separate component

candidate_record_fields.type: closed vocabulary or UNKNOWN
candidate_record_fields.authority: sign/components only; no geological type or physical-response interpretation

candidate_record_fields.type: signed finite-zone horizontal velocity difference
candidate_record_fields.authority: Buck's finite pure-shear-zone meaning; must be bound by a section adapter, not copied from interface v_normal

candidate_record_fields.type: positive physical/model width in metres
candidate_record_fields.authority: explicit ARCANA authorial/model binding, possibly informed by later initialization state

candidate_record_fields.type: lateral initially uniform lithosphere/model domain width in metres
candidate_record_fields.authority: physical support/homogeneity plus numerical boundary-domain definition

candidate_record_fields.type: signed strain rate in s^-1
candidate_record_fields.authority: derive U_x/X_e only after both are governed

candidate_record_fields.type: positive physical duration and causal start/end
candidate_record_fields.authority: positive physical horizon and timestep/interval authorization; revalidation bound alone is insufficient

candidate_record_fields.type: source anchor, successor-model validity, event/model boundaries and interval
candidate_record_fields.authority: B6N2 successor scope plus independently adjudicated horizon

candidate_record_fields.type: named uncertainty components; no invented distributions
candidate_record_fields.authority: source realization, geometry, frame, projection, section, X_e/X_L, model mismatch, time and junction/endpoints

candidate_record_fields.type: supported/unknown/excluded with reason
candidate_record_fields.authority: B6N2 preserves set-valued junction incidence and UNKNOWN accommodation

candidate_record_fields.type: artifact references, hashes, derivation recipe and numerical precision
candidate_record_fields.authority: all parent authority IDs and deterministic recipe identity

candidate_equations.local_components: v_n=delta_v dot n_AB; v_t=delta_v dot t_edge
candidate_equations.candidate_finite_zone_velocity_differenc: U_x_candidate=(v_B(x_B)-v_A(x_A)) dot e_x after the endpoint positions, side identities, endpoint-to-common-frame projection and sign rule are explicitly bound
candidate_equations.strain_rate: epsilon_dot=U_x/X_e, only after both terms are governed
candidate_equations.finite_strain: integral of epsilon_dot(t) over an independently authorized physical interval; no interval or value selected here

candidate_sign_contract.kinematic_normal: n_AB points plate_a to plate_b; positive delta_v dot n_AB means relative opening under the existing R6 diagnostic convention
candidate_sign_contract.Buck_x_polarity: UNBOUND; must explicitly align side A/B, x-axis and extension-positive direction

temporal_separation.source_provenance: instant-only vector source at 210.0 Ma; not extended
temporal_separation.successor_model: explicit restricted B6N2 authority begins at POST_EVENT age 209.97287659484368 Ma
temporal_separation.B6N8A_window: diagnostic shadow experiment only; not a physical forcing duration
temporal_separation.positive_physical_interval: NOT_ESTABLISHED by B6N4-R1; no finite Buck strain can be accumulated

integration_inputs_from_initialization_a: T1 lithosphere base/thickness and crust/Moho geometry on explicit section support
material identity and applicability domain on section and lateral support
candidate input evidence relevant to X_e or X_L, without assuming either width equals a thickness or plate dimension
fail_closed_conditions: unknown/mismatched POST_EVENT state, payload, plate pair or vector authority
missing plate-side membership, section center, endpoint coordinates or section-axis polarity
junction/endpoint support without an explicit admissibility rule
unbound X_e, X_L or endpoint/frame-transport semantics
unresolved unknown physical/event horizon or absent positive physical interval
attempt to infer geological type, fault identity, accommodation, strain, or topology change from rigid motion alone
